channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [8] Room-temperature memristive switching between charge density wave states
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: D. Golež, D. Mihailovic

Authors: R. Venturini, M. Rupnik, J. Gašperlin, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Directly relevant to user's charge-density-wave interests in a real material system (EuTe4).

Tags: #EuTe4 #CDW #phaseswitching

Abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 21 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73267-x Electrically controlled non-volatile resistance switching involving charge density wave states is rare and has been constrained to cryogenic temperature to date. Venturini et al. show the room-temperature electrical control of the charge-density-wave order in EuTe4, holding promise for memory devices.
